items.description: Izak Rankine stars as Adelaide manages to get the job done against Richmond in torrential rain at Adelaide Oval.

items.title: India wary of potential 100% US tariffs over Russian oil
items.description: The US Senate passed a sanctions bill that could result in tariffs on India as a major consumer of Russian oil. Follow DW for more.

items.title: Why is Russia selling its gold?
items.description: Russia has become one of the world's biggest sellers of gold over the past 12 months. It's an attempt to raise cash in the face of budget issues, but not necessarily a sign of a looming financial crisis.

items.title: Talon returns to frontline politics as Benin's first Senate president
items.description: Former Benin president Patrice Talon has been elected the country's first Senate president, months after leaving office. The new upper chamber, created under a constitutional reform, places Talon at the helm of a key institution despite stepping down after two presidential terms.

items.title: Kenyan farmers reject cyanide claims after 15 elephants die in Amboseli
items.description: Farmers bordering Kenya's Amboseli National Park have denied using cyanide after 15 elephants died from suspected poisoning. Wildlife authorities say preliminary tests detected cyanide, but investigations are continuing to determine its source and concentration.

items.title: AfD threatens to cut funding for 'modern-thinking' culture
items.description: The far-right party could win an absolute majority in Saxony-Anhalt's state election in September. Their cultural program denigrates Bauhaus, Holocaust remembrance culture and diversity in theater.

items.title: Trump to appeal ballroom construction halt to Supreme Court
items.description: A US Court of Appeals upheld a ruling that saying Trump cannot build a White House ballroom without congressional approval. The president vowed to appeal what he called an "unjust decision."

items.title: Argentina prison watchdog flags overcrowding and detainee rights concerns
items.description: Argentina’s PPN federal prison watchdog warns of overcrowding, lack of transparency and rights setbacks in annual report. Leer más

items.title: FIFA chief gets backing from African fooball for his re-election bid
items.description: The Confederation of African Football "unanimously reconfirmed" backing for embattled Gianni Infantino, thanking him for supporting the sport on the continent.

items.title: Argentina, China extend currency swap deal
items.description: Central banks of Argentina and China renew US$19-billion bilateral currency swap. Leer más

items.title: Ivory Coast cocoa buyout completed, authorities say
items.description: Ivory Coast’s cocoa buyout operation has been completed, the country’s Coffee-Cocoa Council said in a statement on Thursday.

items.title: Milei retreats even further to pass property bill amid backlash
items.description: Government forced to abandon another section of private property legislation reform. Leer más

items.title: Myanmar's President outlines policy road map, criticises ASEAN peace plan
items.description: President Min Aung Hlaing said he would spend two years accelerating efforts to build a modern and developed nation based on democracy and a federal system, followed by another three years carrying out build-up at full speed.
